newsitem.title: CANADA: Brascan to redeem 1976 series A pfds.
newsitem.headline: Brascan to redeem 1976 series A pfds.

text.p: Brascan Ltd said on Thursday it intends to redeem all of its 281,172 issued and outstanding 1976 8.5-percent series A preferred shares on December 31, 1996 at C$25.44 per share.
Brascan said the C$25.44 per share represents C$25.00 per share plus C$0.44, being the accrued and unpaid dividends up to and including December 30.

The company redeemed all of its issued and outstanding 1976 10-percent series B preferred shares on July 15, 1996 and has continued to redeem any series B preferred shares issued on conversion of its series A preferred shares.
